title: JSFL: library gaps (getItemType, getSelectedItems, moveToFolder, newFolder, duplicateItem, updateItem) + findSymbolInstances + library item timeline
description:
Add to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

JsflLibrary interface + makeLibraryProxy:
1. getItemType(name: string): string - delegates to getItemProperty(name, 'itemType') or returns state.doc.library.items.find(i=>i.name===name)?.type ?? 'graphic'
2. getSelectedItems(): JsflLibraryItem[] - no library selection tracking; return [] stub
3. moveToFolder(folderPath: string, itemToMove?: string, bReplace?: boolean): boolean - console.warn stub, return true
4. newFolder(folderPath: string): boolean - console.warn stub, return true
5. updateItem(name: string): boolean - console.warn stub, return true
6. duplicateItem(name: string): boolean - REAL: find item by name, deep-clone it with a new id and name (e.g. 'Copy of name'), add to library via @flash/core. Return true on success. Look at how addNewItem or library mutation functions work.

JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy:
7. findSymbolInstances(symbolName: string): any[] - REAL: iterate all scenes/layers/keyframes/displayObjects, return element proxies for all SymbolInstances whose symbolId matches the library item named symbolName. Return array of element proxies.

JsflLibraryItem interface extension:
8. timeline property - add optional timeline?: JsflTimeline to JsflLibraryItem interface. In the library items getter, for symbol items (movie clip / button / graphic), return a makeTimelineProxy for that symbol's timeline by finding the symbol in state.doc.library.symbols. This is read-only.
